title: Where a guarded command runs
text: Write guards resolve a relative path against the command's declared workdir, then each leading `cd` joined by `&&`, `;` or a newline. Codex carries the workdir only in its local rollout; the hook client stamps it, matching a code-mode call by its exact command when the hook id is the inner item id. The client's own path answer is used only when it names the same path, so a client that missed the directory cannot move a lane write onto main. Observed in source and tests; deployed harness proof is pending.
